title: Ridayein Ro Rahi Hai
body:
Ridayein ro rahi hai ridayein ro rahi hai
Sar e zainab se mas hokar hawayein ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Yu'n jodhe haath ghairat ka khuda faryad karta hai..
Na maaro tanz ke khanjar ke maayein ro aarahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Saja bazaar e zulmat hai Khule sar aal e at'har hai..
Dil e zainab se aati har sadayein ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wafa ne jis ghadhi dekha sar e naiza sar e ghazi
Wafa ki qibriyai  per wafayein ro rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Qadam sajjad ke hain tar lahu se kya jafayein hain..
Laee'n haste hain aabid per jafayein ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mera allah mere asghar ka turbat me nigehba'n ho..
Ali asghar ki maa'n karke duayein ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Fiza aysi ke dam ghut ta hai bachhi bhi tadapti hai
Sar e zindan sakina par fizaye'n ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ata-e-abid-e-muztar "SHABIH" tum per huyi nazil..
Jo nazil ho rahi hai woh atayein ro rahi hai
